GOOD TO KNOW

This update itself swaps the web proxy the careful way once: a second proxy holds the ports while the first is replaced, so pages and phones stay connected. From the next update on, most updates reach the proxy in place, without replacing it at all.

FOR AGENTS

Customers: opening a customer hides the search and the list, and the customer takes the whole page, with details and history side by side on wide screens. All customers, the Esc key or the browser's Back bring the list back with your last search and place. A customer opened from a call, a conversation or a ticket goes back there with Back.

FOR PLATFORM OPERATORS

No gap in updates: the web proxy used to be stopped and started at the end of every update, dropping pages, live updates and browser phones for a second or two. Now, when the proxy itself has not changed, the release's pages and settings are put in place and the proxy reloads them without closing a connection; when the proxy has changed, a second proxy shares the ports while the first is replaced. A settings file that does not load stops the update before anything changes. The update log says which way each update went.

Faster releases: a release now waits for the checks already running on its commit instead of running them again beside them, and the integration tests have longer to run."}
